expected_answer:
Now receive my last farewell, beloved Walsche congregation of Rotterdam. I hope to continue speaking to you in writings. If it were granted to me, the least of his followers, to take over a word, according to the sound of the Evangelical message once flowed from the always blessed lips of Jesus, I would say to you, with a view to the promotion of that humanism that I have preached among you, as best as I could: 'It is for your benefit that I go away.' Forever

Rotterdam,
7 October 1865.
Your Friend
Allard Pierson.
